title: Piplup's Bubble-Berg
description: Piplup waves from a sculpted ice floe as an orange fish escapes through three rising bubbles. White cheek masks and sparkling eyes frame a rounded golden bill; a navy collar, webbed feet and swept tail complete the captain. Curved and inverted slopes finish the hollow, internally braced sculpture.

sections.name: An iceberg with a narrow bubbling wake
Interlocked body and shaped waving flippers
Bright eyes and rounded golden bill
